name: The Great Glasshouse and the Root Court
reading: Peak Pond Hollow is the garden town where Erika keeps the peace between the residents and the arrivals (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym4_town; moss, packed mud, mud brick, cherry, the garden's plants). One building, walked through. In at the south door onto the green: the Great Glasshouse, a dwarf wall of mud brick and then glass to a glass gable, the gardeners' beds along the front under straw mulch, and three bench runs climbing from them toward the low canopy of the great cherry -- only the planted one (azalea up both flanks, lanterns at its foot) reaches the deck. The deck is the tree's first floor, the whole width of the house, the trunk standing in it and the crown over it under the glass; the court's arch is in the wall behind the trunk, lit, and the living bough's stair goes down from it, four cherry treads, into the Root Court: the round mediation court the gardeners dug into the roots of the great cherry, a round floor of mud brick inlaid with a ring of plank and a round of moss at its middle, a low bar, and four tiers of cherry benches rising round it, roots standing in the tiers and coming through the vault, shroomlights hung in it. Both parties come in by the same stair and the same aisle and stand behind the ring. Erika is not in the ring: she sits on the raised bench of cherry across the north end, four courses over the floor, under a great root of the tree that has come down through the vault behind her: the place of the one who hears both. Out past her by the garden gate in the east tiers (an iron door, its button inside), or back the way you came.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym4_town: moss, packed mud, mud brick, cherry, hay, the garden's plants) plus glass for the house and the roots of the tree. No block here is named by a spawn condition (checked against data/spawn_blocks.json 2026-10-09: azalea_leaves is not, flowering azalea leaves are; no spore blossom, pink petals or cherry leaves). Every leaf block is azalea_leaves[persistent=true]. The carved court's mangrove roots, hanging roots, cave vines and azalea bush are left out: tools/gym_trainers.py does not classify them and would refuse the hall.
